For each event.status represented by the kept lines, report the status, the unrounded average of (amount - spent) across lines where both values are present (blank if none), and the count of all kept lines in that status.

Join each budget line to its event where event.event_id exactly equals budget.link_to_event, dropping unmatched lines. Keep only lines with spent > 6.0. For each event.status represented by the kept lines, report the status, the unrounded average of nonmissing amount values minus the unrounded average of nonmissing spent values (blank if either average has no values), and the count of all kept lines in that status.
queries:
SELECT e.status,
       AVG(b.amount - b.spent) AS average_remaining,
       COUNT(*) AS line_count
FROM budget AS b
JOIN event AS e
  ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event
WHERE b.spent > 6.0
GROUP BY e.status

SELECT e.status,
       AVG(b.amount) - AVG(b.spent),
       COUNT(*)
FROM budget AS b
JOIN event AS e
  ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event
WHERE b.spent > 6.0
GROUP BY e.status
